## 2026-01-28 - [Navigation in Generated Reports]
**Learning:** For CLI tools that generate static reports (like Markdown), users lack the interactive navigation they expect from web UIs. Adding explicit TOCs, anchors, and "Back to Top" links significantly improves usability, especially for long reports. Emojis also help scanability.
**Action:** Always include auto-generated Table of Contents and anchor links in any future Markdown report generators.
